scope: Generic native Flock recording and algebra exporters only. The historical Stage3ArtifactV1 reconstruction, statement wrapper, root-slot mapping, proof codec, and terminal acceptance API are excluded.

sources.reuse: record_fri_circuit_verifier phase composition is a reference for the new generic Exec adapter; the source file is not imported.
Read-only reference. Not imported; native root-discharge callbacks are not closed-relation terminal acceptance.

semantic_changes: Public-slot constants come from the approved CompiledExec template, not mutation probes against one proof's public vector.
Exec-only strict decoding and native verification are owned by ixby-flock; no Stage 2 artifact or legacy fallback is admitted.
Generic circuit binding constrains S = H4(P,B,I,O), public Q = H5(P,B,O), and the exact approved Flock statement prefix. It reconstructs the public vector from fixed words and computed S.
Independent proof-free symbolic wiring and Boolean PIOP compilers reconstruct exact DAGs and PCS claim wires from CompiledExec; native replay must match them structurally.

Proof-free merged PCS, multipoint/anchor, inner Ligerito, and complete main transcript operation-tree compilers pin all fixed dimensions, addresses, labels, forks/merges, private slots, and PoW policies; no verifier/prover or witness value is used to construct them.

Proof-free auxiliary matrix/structure/jagged fold compilation and pure operation-tree-to-BLAKE3 lowering cover both complete transcripts without hash evaluation or dummy values. Exact native topology comparison excludes only concrete CV/message witness columns, whose validity remains a circuit obligation.

compile_exec_replay accepts only approved CompiledExec setup and returns an immutable borrowed topology with fourteen distinct component identities. The same compiled object is reused for different guests and branch outcomes; no proof-dependent shape is adopted as key material.

Witness replay and its proof-free topology compiler are not proof-free R1CS/key compilation or terminal acceptance certificates. Root closure, full proving, and those remaining setup obligations are tracked separately.

Initial M6 prototype code compiles exact setup-owned sparse root tables to bounded decision diagrams, including structure constant-pin plane 5 and the complete jagged layout. A neutral F128 R1CS gadget evaluates their MLEs without value hints. Its initial component-only measurements precede the separate closed composition below; the diagnostic root-conditional path is preserved.

The exact all-table native differential, one actual-table materialized R1CS, and bounded variable-order/cofactor-XOR experiments are recorded separately in census/exec-fixed-root-table-prototype-v0.json with source hashes. Most rewrites grow or fail their resource bounds and are not adopted by default. No Stage 3 table, profile, key, or transcript was changed.

The separate structural BLAKE3 prototype ports the pinned Option-F linear row formulas into shared XOR maps. It accepts them only after exhaustive coefficient equality with both approved registry matrices. The original formula-source hash was recorded before the port; provenance, neutral-gadget tests, native differentials, and complete component-only R1CS/PLONK censuses are retained in census/exec-structural-blake3-root-v0.json. Neither the root-conditional acceptance relation nor any Stage 3 table/profile/key/transcript is changed.

compile_exec_root_closure derives a complete immutable ordered set from the approved replay: two coefficient-checked BLAKE3 linear programs, 44 other matrix diagrams, and exact structure/jagged diagrams. No guest, point, value, statement, or proof is a compilation input. The current implementation temporarily builds all diagrams, with global limits including the discarded BLAKE3 diagrams, then runs separately bounded exact linear validation.

constrain_exec_root_closed shares the complete replay body with the diagnostic root-conditional entry point, preserving the latter's public allocation/emission order. At every family-binding site it computes exact table evaluations from existing constrained fold point wires and equates existing claims; no new root witness or native discharge callback is used. Its only public input is the externally expected two-limb Q. This is a composition prototype, not proof-free R1CS/key compilation or a generated complete proof.

A fallible matrix-free R1CS observer latches the first resource/error refusal; subsequent emissions do no work, allocations and both finish methods fail. A separate PLONK prefix type and closed-census outcome distinguish refused prefixes from complete counts/digests. The bounded closed census caps required rows at the supported FFLONK size-4n FFT geometry, including public/blinding reservations. It is not host-resource or setup approval.

Materialized synthetic root-binding tests cover both program types, all families, every changed claim bit, and missing/duplicate/reordered/malformed identities. Native setup compiles all tables twice before three different guest/outcome proofs; all 48 roots match the independent native folds. Native comparisons and bounded-prefix tests are not a full closed-relation satisfying-assignment check or FFLONK proof.

The bounded full-emission test rejected the current closed encoding at 643831813 R1CS constraints and 1073741821 PLONK constraint rows: with two public and two blinding rows, the prefix crosses the supported 2^30 domain. It stops before completing the relation and returns no full R1CS projection digest/census. Exact source hashes, commands, 1245.361-second emission duration, and process-memory scope are retained in census/exec-root-closed-admission-v0.json. No full closed-relation materialization, SRS, terminal key or proof was produced.
